d: Vishesh gahan punrikshan yani ke dauran ka jor ek hi bat raha- 'koee bhi patr matdata chhut na jae'. yahan tak ki mukhy chunav aayukt gyanesh kumar aur chunav aayog ki tamam pres rilij se lekar pres konphrens tak yahi nara dohraya gaya. lekin uttarakhand ke gadarpur nirvachan kshetr men antim matdata suchi ki partal ke dauran hamen kuchh aur hi kahani najar aaee.
